## Issues

<!--
Put a closing keyword directly before the number of each issue this finishes:

  Closes #NNN, closes #MMM    each number needs its own keyword
  Closes #NNN #MMM            closes the first one only
  Refs #NNN                   links without closing, for partial work

Measured here twice: a body containing "close #NNN" closed that issue two
seconds after the merge, once as ordinary prose and once quoted inside a
fenced code block. Quoting does not exempt it, so a keyword and a number you
